name: Momentigrade
description:
About This Game

Unique Blend of Combat and Parkour

Chain together dashes, wall kicks, pole swings and more in order to overcome platforming challenges, and reach new heights! Combat is centered around dodging and platforming around foes. Put both your platforming and combat skills to the test in challenging boss fights!

Handcrafted Metroidvania World

Make your way through a dense, highly vertical city. Progression is non-linear and paths are blocked based on your abilities. Start with a limited moveset and unlock new abilities as you explore. Return to previous areas and use your new movement skills to find upgrades and collectibles. 

Short but Sweet

Get a full Metroidvania experience in around 3 - 4 hours, more if you have a careful eye and a yearning to uncover secrets. Replay to discover routes you didn't see at first, hidden areas, and opportunities to sequence break.

Additional Features:

  • Melody forward soundtrack

  • Hidden Collectibles

  • Unlockable outfits

  • Optional time-trial challenges
short_desc: A fast-paced 3D Metroidvania with a focus on stylish, momentum driven movement. Chain together jumps, dashes, wall kicks, and pole swings as you explore a colorful interconnected city and climb into the clouds. Fight creatures, discover secrets, and see how long you can keep the flow going.
